import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
import verify_current_scientific_premises as v
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
base="291bbd73584318f87697345cd86c48f17064e5de"
prefix="udt_gw_response_robustness_design_campaign/"
git=["git","-c","core.preloadIndex=false"]
call=lambda *a:subprocess.check_output(git+list(a),text=True)
assert call("branch","--show-current").strip()=="grok"
paths=["AGENTS.md","CLAUDE.md","CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.md","CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.tsv","verify_current_scientific_premises.py","CANON.md","UDT_METRIC_KERNEL_DEVELOPMENT.md","UDT_METRIC_KERNEL_COVERAGE.tsv"]
hashes={}
for name in paths:
 actual=(root/name).read_bytes()
 old=subprocess.check_output(git+["show",base+":"+name])
 assert actual==old,name
 hashes[name]=hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest()
old_packages=["udt_complementary_wave_observable_campaign_2026-09-07","udt_gw170817_fixed_window_test_campaign_2026-09-07"]
assert not call("diff","--name-only",base,"--",*old_packages).strip()
names=sorted(x for x in call("status","--short").splitlines() if x.startswith("?? ") and not x[3:].startswith(prefix))
nh=hashlib.sha256("\n".join(names).encode()).hexdigest()
assert len(names)==46 and nh=="d65d71d63a56b95aabfd61f33317b1f1f2b2a62a85ded8258c525b99a5e156ea"
allowed={"LIVE.md","HANDOFF.md","CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md"}
assert all(x in allowed or x.startswith(prefix) for x in call("diff","--name-only",base).splitlines())
v.validate_startup_surface(root)
subprocess.run(git+["diff","--check"],check=True)
print(json.dumps(dict(scope="scoped startup and byte-preservation check, not full premise replay or science review",baseline=base,head=call("rev-parse","HEAD").strip(),preserved_sha256=hashes,previous_CO_FW_packages_unchanged=True,unrelated_name_count=len(names),unrelated_name_hash=nh,protected_payload_contents_inspected=False,scoped_startup_surface_pass=True,backup_completeness="UNVERIFIED",pre_reboot_unsaved_state="UNVERIFIED",host_process_inventory="UNVERIFIED"),indent=2))
